name: Microsoft Dynamics 365
label: Dataverse Web API v9.2 — Dynamics 365 Sales tables
description: Official Microsoft Dataverse Web API v9.2 (OData 4.0) for Dynamics 365 Sales. Creates/updates post official logical names (name, emailaddress1, firstname, …) at the JSON root; lookups use *_bind → @odata.bind. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/data-platform/webapi/create-table-row. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Example keys match api_spec.json required/queryFrom/bodyFrom.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: account.create | account.get | account.list | account.update | account.delete | contact.create | contact.get | contact.list | contact.update | contact.delete | lead.create | lead.get | lead.list | lead.update | lead.convert | opportunity.create | opportunity.get | opportunity.list | opportunity.update | opportunity.delete | incident.create | incident.get | incident.list | incident.update | activity.create | whoami | fetchXml.query | trigger.listen.

schema.label: org_host
schema.description: Dataverse hostname only (no scheme). Example: contoso.crm.dynamics.com. All HTTP operations; also a config default.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Entity GUID (braces optional) for get/update/delete/convert. Path accounts({id}) etc. Example: 11bb11bb-cc22-dd33-ee44-55ff55ff55ff.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: Escape-hatch column map sent as JSON key fields (Dataverse ignores unknown keys — prefer the purpose fields which are posted at the JSON root). Extra custom columns go here only if you accept that wrap.

schema.label: activity_set
schema.description: activity.create entity set. EXACT: tasks | emails | phonecalls | appointments.

schema.label: entity_set
schema.description: fetchXml.query entity-set name. Example: accounts.

schema.label: fetch_xml
schema.description: FetchXML query for fetchXml.query. Wired as query fetchXml. Example: <fetch>...</fetch>.

schema.label: CreateAccount
schema.description: QualifyLead CreateAccount. lead.convert. Official PascalCase body field.

schema.label: CreateContact
schema.description: QualifyLead CreateContact. lead.convert.

schema.label: CreateOpportunity
schema.description: QualifyLead CreateOpportunity. lead.convert.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: QualifyLead Status option-set. lead.convert. Typical 3 = Qualified.

schema.label: create_account
schema.description: Legacy alias for lead.convert (kept). Prefer CreateAccount.

schema.label: create_contact
schema.description: Legacy alias for lead.convert (kept). Prefer CreateContact.

schema.label: create_opportunity
schema.description: Legacy alias for lead.convert (kept). Prefer CreateOpportunity.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Legacy alias for lead.convert Status (kept). Prefer Status.

schema.label: $select
schema.description: OData $select for get/list. Comma-separated logical names. Example: name,emailaddress1.

schema.label: $filter
schema.description: OData $filter for list. Example: name eq 'Contoso'.

schema.label: $orderby
schema.description: OData $orderby for list. Example: createdon desc.

schema.label: $top
schema.description: OData $top page size for list. Example: 20.

schema.label: name
schema.description: account.name / opportunity.name. Official logical name. Example: Contoso Ltd. Used by account.create/update, opportunity.create/update.

schema.label: telephone1
schema.description: Primary phone. Official telephone1. account/contact/lead create and update. Example: +1-425-555-0100.

schema.label: emailaddress1
schema.description: Primary email. Official emailaddress1. account/contact/lead create and update. Example: ada@contoso.com.

schema.label: websiteurl
schema.description: Website URL. Official websiteurl. account create/update. Example: https://contoso.com.

schema.label: address1_line1
schema.description: Street line 1. Official address1_line1. account/contact/lead create and update.

schema.label: address1_city
schema.description: City. Official address1_city.

schema.label: address1_stateorprovince
schema.description: State or province. Official address1_stateorprovince. Example: WA.

schema.label: address1_postalcode
schema.description: Postal code. Official address1_postalcode.

schema.label: address1_country
schema.description: Country. Official address1_country. Example: United States.

schema.label: description
schema.description: Description / notes. Official description. account/contact/lead/opportunity/incident/activity.

schema.label: firstname
schema.description: Contact/lead first name. Official firstname. Example: Ada.

schema.label: lastname
schema.description: Contact/lead last name. Official lastname. Example: Lovelace.

schema.label: jobtitle
schema.description: Contact/lead job title. Official jobtitle.

schema.label: mobilephone
schema.description: Mobile phone. Official mobilephone. contact/lead.

schema.label: uma.s@example.org
schema.description: Contact parent customer lookup. Official @odata.bind URL. Example: /accounts(guid). contact.create/update.

schema.label: companyname
schema.description: Lead company name. Official companyname. lead.create/update.

schema.label: subject
schema.description: Lead topic or activity subject. Official subject. lead.* and activity.create.

schema.label: estimatedvalue
schema.description: Opportunity estimated value. Official estimatedvalue. Example: 25000.

schema.label: estimatedclosedate
schema.description: Opportunity estimated close date YYYY-MM-DD. Official estimatedclosedate.

schema.label: diana.k@example.org
schema.description: Opportunity parent account lookup. Official @odata.bind URL. Example: /accounts(guid).

schema.label: yosef.c@example.com
schema.description: Opportunity parent contact lookup. Official @odata.bind URL. Example: /contacts(guid).

schema.label: title
schema.description: Case title. Official title. incident.create/update. Example: Cannot sign in.

schema.label: nathan.k@example.net
schema.description: Case customer lookup. Official @odata.bind URL. Example: /contacts(guid) or /accounts(guid).

schema.label: prioritycode
schema.description: Case priority option-set. Official prioritycode. Typical: 1 High, 2 Normal, 3 Low.

schema.label: scheduledend
schema.description: Activity due datetime. Official scheduledend. activity.create. Example: 2026-11-01T17:00:00Z.

schema.label: carol.w@example.org
schema.description: Activity regarding lookup. Official @odata.bind URL. Example: /accounts(guid).

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. Size-capped. Never log secrets or raw PII.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: account.create | account.get | account.list | account.update | account.delete | contact.create | contact.get | contact.list | contact.update | contact.delete | lead.create | lead.get | lead.list | lead.update | lead.convert | opportunity.create | opportunity.get | opportunity.list | opportunity.update | opportunity.delete | incident.create | incident.get | incident.list | incident.update | activity.create | whoami | fetchXml.query | trigger.listen.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: Entra Bearer (StudioQuack secret). OAuth access token minted outside StudioQuack. Scope {orgUrl}/.default. Never on INPUT. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Organization host
configurationParameters.description: Dataverse hostname only, no scheme or path. Documented pattern: {org}.crm.dynamics.com or {org}.api.crm.dynamics.com (plus published sovereign hosts). HTTPS is applied by the spec (baseUrl https: + //{org_host}/api/data/v9.2). Reject IP literals in the operator runbook.

configurationParameters.label: API version
configurationParameters.description: Dataverse Web API version path segment, e.g. v9.2. Interpolated into baseUrl /api/data/{api_version}.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 30. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) supporting URL key, X-SQ-WEBHOOK-KEY header, or k/{keyId} with provider secret header.

configurationParameters.label: Dataverse Webhook Key Header
configurationParameters.description: Provider webhook secret verified in constant time against inbound header X-Dataverse-Token. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Auth Header Name
configurationParameters.description: HTTP header name carrying the provider webhook secret (default: X-Dataverse-Token).
